    '2026-06-17'::DATE AS today,
    '2026-06-17'::DATE - INTERVAL '90 days' AS last_90_start,
    '2026-06-17'::DATE - INTERVAL '180 days' AS prior_90_start
),
last_90 AS (
  SELECT
    o.STORE_ID,
    SUM(o.SUBTOTAL) AS revenue_last_90
  FROM ORDERS o
  CROSS JOIN date_ranges d
  WHERE o.ORDERED_AT >= d.last_90_start
  GROUP BY o.STORE_ID
),
prior_90 AS (
  SELECT
    o.STORE_ID,
    SUM(o.SUBTOTAL) AS revenue_prior_90
  FROM ORDERS o
  CROSS JOIN date_ranges d
  WHERE o.ORDERED_AT >= d.prior_90_start
    AND o.ORDERED_AT < d.last_90_start
  GROUP BY o.STORE_ID
),
combined AS (
  SELECT
    COALESCE(l.STORE_ID, p.STORE_ID) AS STORE_ID,
    COALESCE(l.revenue_last_90, 0) AS revenue_last_90,
    COALESCE(p.revenue_prior_90, 0) AS revenue_prior_90
  FROM last_90 l
  FULL OUTER JOIN prior_90 p ON l.STORE_ID = p.STORE_ID
)
SELECT
  STORE_ID,
  revenue_last_90,
  revenue_prior_90,
  CASE
    WHEN revenue_prior_90 = 0 THEN NULL
    ELSE ROUND(((revenue_last_90 - revenue_prior_90) / revenue_prior_90) * 100, 2)
  END AS growth_rate_percent
FROM combined
ORDER BY STORE_ID;

WITH periods AS (
    SELECT
        STORE_ID,
        SUM(CASE WHEN ORDERED_AT >= TIMESTAMP '2026-06-17' - INTERVAL 90 DAY THEN SUBTOTAL ELSE 0 END) AS revenue_last_90,
        SUM(CASE WHEN ORDERED_AT >= TIMESTAMP '2026-06-17' - INTERVAL 180 DAY
                  AND ORDERED_AT < TIMESTAMP '2026-06-17' - INTERVAL 90 DAY THEN SUBTOTAL ELSE 0 END) AS revenue_prior_90
    FROM ORDERS
    WHERE ORDERED_AT >= TIMESTAMP '2026-06-17' - INTERVAL 180 DAY
    GROUP BY STORE_ID
)
SELECT
    s.STORE_NAME,
    p.STORE_ID,
    ROUND(p.revenue_last_90, 2) AS revenue_last_90_days,
    ROUND(p.revenue_prior_90, 2) AS revenue_prior_90_days,
    CASE
        WHEN p.revenue_prior_90 = 0 THEN NULL
        ELSE ROUND(100.0 * (p.revenue_last_90 - p.revenue_prior_90) / p.revenue_prior_90, 2)
    END AS growth_rate_pct
FROM periods p
JOIN STORES s ON p.STORE_ID = s.STORE_ID
ORDER BY growth_rate_pct DESC NULLS LAST;

    - SUM(CASE WHEN O.ORDERED_AT >= DATE '2026-06-17' - INTERVAL 180 DAY AND O.ORDERED_AT < DATE '2026-06-17' - INTERVAL 90 DAY THEN O.SUBTOTAL ELSE 0 END)
  ) / NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN O.ORDERED_AT >= DATE '2026-06-17' - INTERVAL 180 DAY AND O.ORDERED_AT < DATE '2026-06-17' - INTERVAL 90 DAY THEN O.SUBTOTAL ELSE 0 END), 0) AS GROWTH_RATE_PCT

SELECT
  DATE_TRUNC('month', OI.CREATED_AT)::DATE AS MONTH,
  SUM(SUM(CASE WHEN OI.STATUS NOT IN ('Cancelled', 'Returned') THEN OI.SALE_PRICE ELSE 0 END))
    OVER (ORDER BY DATE_TRUNC('month', OI.CREATED_AT)) AS CUMULATIVE_REVENUE
FROM ORDER_ITEMS OI
WHERE OI.STATUS NOT IN ('Cancelled', 'Returned')
GROUP BY DATE_TRUNC('month', OI.CREATED_AT)
ORDER BY MONTH;

WITH REVENUE_BY_PRODUCT AS (
  SELECT
    P.CATEGORY,
    P.ID,
    P.NAME,
    SUM(OI.SALE_PRICE) AS TOTAL_REVENUE
  FROM ORDER_ITEMS OI
  JOIN PRODUCTS P ON OI.PRODUCT_ID = P.ID
  WHERE OI.STATUS NOT IN ('Cancelled', 'Returned')

),

  SELECT
    CATEGORY,
    ID,
    NAME,
    TOTAL_REVENUE,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY CATEGORY ORDER BY TOTAL_REVENUE DESC) AS RN

)

  ID,
  NAME,
  TOTAL_REVENUE

WITH order_amounts AS (
  SELECT
    o.CUSTOMER_ID,
    c.CUSTOMER_UNIQUE_ID,
    o.ORDER_PURCHASE_TIMESTAMP,
    SUM(oi.PRICE) AS order_total
  FROM ORDERS o
  LEFT JOIN ORDER_ITEMS oi ON o.ORDER_ID = oi.ORDER_ID
  LEFT JOIN CUSTOMERS c ON o.CUSTOMER_ID = c.CUSTOMER_ID
  WHERE o.ORDER_STATUS = 'delivered'
    AND o.ORDER_DELIVERED_CUSTOMER_DATE IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY o.CUSTOMER_ID, c.CUSTOMER_UNIQUE_ID, o.ORDER_PURCHASE_TIMESTAMP
),
recent_90_days AS (
  SELECT
    CUSTOMER_UNIQUE_ID,
    SUM(order_total) AS spending_last_90
  FROM order_amounts
  WHERE ORDER_PURCHASE_TIMESTAMP >= CAST('2026-05-30' AS DATE) - INTERVAL 90 DAY
  GROUP BY CUSTOMER_UNIQUE_ID
),
prior_90_days AS (
  SELECT
    CUSTOMER_UNIQUE_ID,
    SUM(order_total) AS spending_prior_90
  FROM order_amounts
  WHERE ORDER_PURCHASE_TIMESTAMP >= CAST('2026-05-30' AS DATE) - INTERVAL 180 DAY
    AND ORDER_PURCHASE_TIMESTAMP < CAST('2026-05-30' AS DATE) - INTERVAL 90 DAY
  GROUP BY CUSTOMER_UNIQUE_ID
),
comparison AS (
  SELECT
    COALESCE(r.CUSTOMER_UNIQUE_ID, p.CUSTOMER_UNIQUE_ID) AS CUSTOMER_UNIQUE_ID,
    COALESCE(r.spending_last_90, 0) AS spending_last_90,
    COALESCE(p.spending_prior_90, 0) AS spending_prior_90
  FROM recent_90_days r
  FULL OUTER JOIN prior_90_days p ON r.CUSTOMER_UNIQUE_ID = p.CUSTOMER_UNIQUE_ID
)
SELECT COUNT(*) AS customer_count
FROM comparison
WHERE spending_last_90 > spending_prior_90;
